paragraphs: From Letterkenny test centre on Pearse Road, move off and take your 1st left onto Oliver Plunkett Road
Continue for a couple of hundred metres turn left onto Lower Main Street
At the roundabout at the end of Main Street take the slight right onto Ballymacool Street
Turn right to stay on Ballymacool Street as it bends around
The road name changes as you go, first becoming Convent Road, then College Row, and finally Glencar Road
Keep straight ahead through these name changes, watching your speed and lane discipline
Turn left onto Sallaghagrane left again onto Glencar Irish, followed by another left back onto Sallaghagrane
Take the next right to stay on Sallaghagrane, and use the quiet unnamed road ahead to practice a turnabout (U-turn) manoeuvre
After the turnabout come back out and go left onto Sallaghagrane
Right to continue along it, and at the end of the road turn right onto Glencar Irish
Carry straight on as the road becomes Circular Road for nearly a kilometre
At the Ballyboe Glencar roundabout take the slight left and continue straight through the exit
Go straight through the Knocknamona Roundabout as well, staying on the unnamed road beyond it
Turn right onto Old Farm Road right into Whitethorn Park, which is a good spot to practice a residential-area stop and reverse
Move off again take the left into Whitethorn Grove
Right onto Whitethorn, and use the unnamed road to complete another turnabout
Come back left into Whitethorn Grove, keep right to stay on it, and follow the slight left back onto Whitethorn Park
At the end of the road turn right onto Old Farm Road
Left at the next end of road onto Gortlee Road
At the roundabout take the left exit continue straight through the next roundabout exit
Pull in briefly on the unnamed road for any final checks, then move off again and at the next roundabout take the right exit, followed by a slight left, then straight out onto the unnamed road beyond
At the small rotary take the slight left onto Neil T Blaney Road and follow it for about a kilometre
Take the slight left onto the unnamed road, then straight onto Paddy Harte Road, which brings you back to Pearse Road
To finish, move off on Pearse Road turn left onto Justice Walsh Road
Left onto Upper Main Street and pull in on the right to return to the Letterkenny test centre
